REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection string for caching, rate limiting, and idempotency. Required in production; also required in staging when EXTERNAL_AUDIT_IMPORT_ENABLED=true. Must not be localhost in those environments.

CELERY_BROKER_URL.description: Celery broker URL (typically Redis). Required in production; also required in staging when EXTERNAL_AUDIT_IMPORT_ENABLED=true. No silent localhost default in those environments.

CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND.description: Celery result backend URL. Required in production (and staging with imports); typically a Redis DB index distinct from the broker.

SECRET_KEY.description: Application secret key for JWT signing

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: API rate limit per minute per user

DATA_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Default data retention period in days

COMPLIANCE_SCHEDULE_ENABLED.description: Enable Compliance Schedule module (organisation/location obligations). Default false; kill switch can only subtract.

COMPLIANCE_SCHEDULE_FRA_OCR_ENABLED.description: Enable FRA/PAS79 OCR ingest on Compliance Schedule (ANDed with COMPLIANCE_SCHEDULE_ENABLED). Default false in code; set true to open.

COMPLIANCE_FILING_INDEX_ENABLED.description: When true, Compliance Schedule File-to-Library (occurrence filing and FRA OCR draft filing) creates an IndexJob so the filed DRAFT is chunked and searchable. Default false; governance status stays DRAFT (not auto-APPROVED). Persist via deploy vars like FRA OCR.

COMPLIANCE_SCHEDULE_FRA_OCR_ACTIONS_ENAB.description: When true, confirming an FRA OCR draft creates CAPA actions for operator-checked priority rows only (ANDed with FRA OCR ingest). Default false; persist via deploy vars like FRA OCR.

COMPLIANCE_SCHEDULE_FRA_OCR_RISK_ENABLED.description: When true, confirming an FRA OCR draft may create one Enterprise Risk when the operator supplies likelihood and impact (never from OCR alone). Default false; persist via deploy vars like FRA OCR actions.

DOCUMENT_GRAPH_ENABLED.description: Enable Library Document Relationship Graph (ADR-0021). Default false; never conflate with Golden Thread. Persist via deploy vars like FRA OCR.

DOCUMENT_GRAPH_HEURISTIC_PROPOSE_ENABLED.description: Enable non-LLM Doc Graph heuristic propose (ANDed with DOCUMENT_GRAPH_ENABLED). Default false. Keep IMPACT/LLM propose off for Wave 1 bake.

DOCUMENT_GRAPH_THREAD_AMBIENT_ENABLED.description: Show the ambient Doc Graph thread strip (ADR-0021 X-0). ANDed with DOCUMENT_GRAPH_ENABLED. Default false; persist via deploy vars so it is not a hand-set app setting (WE-1).

DOCUMENT_GRAPH_MAP_VIEW_ENABLED.description: Offer the Relationships Map|List toggle (DG-1). ANDed with DOCUMENT_GRAPH_ENABLED. Confirm stays a list queue whatever this is set to. Default false; persist via deploy vars (WE-1).

DOCUMENT_GRAPH_DND_PROPOSE_ENABLED.description: Allow drag-and-drop propose onto the relationships map (DG-2). Drops are always proposed, never confirmed. ANDed with DOCUMENT_GRAPH_ENABLED. Default false; persist via deploy vars (WE-1).

DOCUMENT_GRAPH_STRUCTURE_MAP_ENABLED.description: Expose the read-only library Structure Map page (DG-3). Never the default confirm surface. ANDed with DOCUMENT_GRAPH_ENABLED. Default false; persist via deploy vars (WE-1).
